# Planora 1.7.5
Planora 1.7.5 修复 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上的多项任务交互与布局问题，并改进 Mac 安装包的可移植性。
## 中文
### iPhone / iPad
- 修复在首页周历中点击日期、切换周历/月历或重新布局时可能出现界面卡住并最终闪退的问题。 - 修复 iPad 上周历/月历切换过程中系统 `List` 单元格高度在不同值之间反复变化并触发 UIKit 布局循环的问题。 - 调整周历与月历的嵌套布局，避免日历内容参与不稳定的尺寸反馈。 - 改进不同 iPhone 与 iPad 宽度下的日历自适应布局，同时保留现有 iOS / iPadOS 导航与系统界面逻辑。
### 任务交互
- 修复任务左滑操作时只有文字和内容移动、白色任务卡片背景留在原位的问题。 - 任务卡片背景现在与任务内容一起参与滑动，使左滑操作保持完整一致。
### Mac
- 修复首次打开任务详情时明显卡顿、详情内容延迟出现的问题。 - 减少打开任务详情过程中不必要的全任务查询和保存操作，使详情视图更快显示。 - 改进任务详情区域的窗口缩放逻辑，降低不必要的最小宽度限制，使任务详情在较窄窗口下仍能正常使用。 - 修复正常缩小 Mac 窗口时任务详情内容可能被挤出可用区域的问题。 - 改进任务工作区筛选控件的响应式布局，使其能够根据可用宽度调整排列。 - 保留现有 SwiftData 数据、任务关系、重复任务删除范围、Mac 原生工作区以及数据迁移逻辑。
### DMG
- 修复 DMG 安装背景依赖开发 Mac 本地路径的问题。 - 安装背景现在真正存储在 DMG 内部隐藏的 `.background` 目录中。 - Finder 的背景配置引用磁盘映像内部资源，不再依赖开发机器上的绝对文件路径。 - DMG 继续包含 Planora、Applications 快捷方式和 `INSTALLATION.txt`。 - 发布包继续提供 Sparkle 更新 ZIP、DMG 和 SHA-256 校验值。
### 验证
- iPhone 回归测试通过，包括周历反复切换、日期变化和窄屏布局。 - 在 iPad 上复现并修复周历/月历切换导致的 UIKit 布局循环问题。 - Mac Release 构建通过，并检查任务详情在多种窗口宽度下的布局与加载行为。 - 最终 DMG 已重新挂载检查，确认隐藏背景资源、Finder 配置、Applications 快捷方式、安装说明、App 签名和磁盘映像完整性。 - Planora 1.7.5 保持版本号 `1.7.5`、build `20`。
### 更新系统
- Mac 软件更新继续使用 Sparkle 2.9.6。 - Sparkle 仍仅包含在 macOS 版本中。 - 更新 ZIP 继续使用 Ed25519 签名验证。 - Sparkle 私钥仍只保存在发布环境的 Keychain 中，不提交到 Git。 - 本版本仍未使用 Apple Developer ID 公证；Sparkle 签名与 Apple Developer ID / notarization 相互独立。
---
## English
Planora 1.7.5 fixes several task interaction and layout issues across iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and improves the portability of the Mac installer.
### iPhone / iPad
- Fixed an issue where interacting with dates in the Home calendar, switching between week and month views, or relaying out the calendar could cause the interface to become unresponsive and eventually crash. - Fixed an iPad issue where the system `List` cell height could repeatedly oscillate between different values during week/month transitions and eventually trigger a UIKit layout-loop assertion. - Adjusted the nested week and month calendar layouts to avoid unstable size-feedback behavior. - Improved calendar adaptation across different iPhone and iPad widths while preserving the existing iOS / iPadOS navigation and system interface behavior.
### Task Interaction
- Fixed task swipe actions where the text and content moved while the white task-card background remained stationary. - The complete task card now moves consistently with the swipe interaction.
### Mac
- Fixed noticeable delays and temporary loading stalls when opening a task detail view for the first time. - Reduced unnecessary full-task queries and save operations while opening task details so the detail view can appear more quickly. - Improved task-detail window resizing by reducing unnecessary minimum-width constraints, allowing the workspace to remain usable at narrower window sizes. - Fixed task-detail content being pushed outside the usable area during normal Mac window resizing. - Improved the responsive layout of task-workspace filter controls so they can adapt to the available width. - Preserved existing SwiftData content, task relationships, recurring-task deletion scopes, the native Mac workspace, and existing migration behavior.
### DMG
- Fixed the DMG installation background depending on a local path on the development Mac. - The installation background is now physically stored inside the disk image under the hidden `.background` directory. - Finder now references the background resource inside the mounted disk image instead of an absolute path on the development machine. - The DMG continues to contain Planora, an Applications shortcut, and `INSTALLATION.txt`. - The release continues to provide the Sparkle update ZIP, DMG, and SHA-256 checksums.
### Validation
- Passed iPhone regression coverage including repeated week-calendar switching, date changes, and narrow-width layouts. - Reproduced and fixed the UIKit layout loop triggered by week/month calendar transitions on iPad. - Passed the Mac Release build and checked task-detail loading and layout behavior at multiple window widths. - Remounted and verified the final DMG, including its hidden background resource, Finder configuration, Applications shortcut, installation guide, application signature, and disk-image integrity. - Planora remains version `1.7.5`, build `20`.
### Update System
- Mac software updates continue to use Sparkle 2.9.6. - Sparkle remains macOS-only. - Update archives continue to use Ed25519 signature verification. - The Sparkle private key remains in the release environment's Keychain and is not committed to Git. - This release is still not Apple Developer ID notarized; Sparkle signing remains independent from Apple Developer ID signing and notarization.

# Planora 1.7.4
## 中文
Planora 1.7.4 主要改善 iPhone 与 iPad 在 iOS / iPadOS 26 下的首页兼容性，同时继续保持新版系统和 Mac 原有的界面与数据逻辑。
### iPhone 与 iPad
- 修复 iOS / iPadOS 26 首页出现大面积系统 List 白色背景的问题。 - 修复 iOS / iPadOS 26 首页头像和通知按钮旁错误出现跳转箭头的问题。 - 修复窄屏下「成绩」「即将到来的任务」等首页标题被挤压、换行或贴边的问题。 - 调整首页 List 的行背景、间距和内容边距，使旧系统兼容界面与 Planora 原有设计保持一致。 - 优化 iPad 首页周历响应式布局，在空间充足时使用七列周视图，并在较窄宽度下自动调整。 - 保留 iOS / iPadOS 27 的系统导航、TabView 与 Liquid Glass 界面逻辑，不使用旧系统兼容布局替换新版界面。 - 增加 iOS / iPadOS 26 首页兼容性回归测试，覆盖 iPhone 与 iPad。 - 重新验证 ManageBac 首次连接和任务导入流程，当前导入正常。 - ManageBac 导入继续使用重复安全的数据处理方式，避免重复标识导致导入崩溃。 - 不通过清空数据库解决重复数据问题，继续保留用户已有任务、课程、成绩、Unit、教师及其他本地数据。
### Mac
- 保持 Planora 1.7.3 已建立的原生 Mac 工作区和数据逻辑。 - 保持主窗口与设置使用统一的数据容器。 - 保持现有 SwiftData 存储和迁移逻辑。 - 保持签名的软件更新 feed 与更新归档。 - 保持带中英文安装背景的 DMG 发布方式。 - DMG 继续提供独立的 `INSTALLATION.txt`。 - 本次 iPhone / iPad 兼容性调整不改变 Mac 的主要工作流。
### Vendor / 第三方组件
- Mac 软件更新继续使用 Sparkle 2.9.6。 - Sparkle 仅用于 macOS target。 - iPhone 与 iPad 构建不包含 Sparkle 更新框架。 - Sparkle 用于检查更新、更新说明、下载、签名验证、安装与重新启动。 - Planora 更新归档继续使用 Ed25519 签名验证。 - 更新 feed 继续使用签名 appcast。 - Sparkle 私钥不提交至 Git 仓库，仅保存在发布环境的 Keychain 中。 - Sparkle 更新签名不等同于 Apple Developer ID 签名或 Apple notarization。 - `Vendor/Sparkle` 保持为 Mac 更新系统的本地 Vendor 依赖。
### DMG
- DMG 使用内嵌的中英文安装背景。 - 背景位于磁盘映像内部，不依赖开发 Mac 的绝对文件路径。 - DMG 包含 Planora、Applications 快捷方式和 `INSTALLATION.txt`。 - Finder 默认使用图标视图显示安装界面。 - 安装说明同时提供中文和英文。 - 发布前检查 DMG 映像完整性、背景、应用和安装说明。 - 发布文件生成 SHA-256 校验值。
### 验证
- 已在 iOS 26.5 iPhone Simulator 实际复现并修复首页兼容性布局。 - 已检查 iPadOS 26.5 Simulator 首页布局。 - 已检查首页白底、错误箭头、标题布局和周历响应式显示。 - 已重新测试 ManageBac 新用户连接与任务导入，导入正常。 - 保留 iOS / iPadOS 27 原有界面实现。 - Xcode Version 与 Build Number 已在发布前完成设置，本次发布脚本不再次修改。
## 已知问题
Planora 1.7.4 当前有一个已知问题：
**在 iPhone 或 iPad 上点击主页周历中的日期或周区域时，可能导致界面卡住并随后崩溃。**
在后续版本修复前，建议移动端用户暂时不要点击主页周历中的日期或周区域。
任务管理、ManageBac 导入、任务列表、创建任务及其他主要功能不受此问题影响。
---
## English
Planora 1.7.4 primarily improves Home compatibility on iPhone and iPad running iOS / iPadOS 26 while preserving the existing newer-system and Mac interface and data architecture.
### iPhone and iPad
- Fixed the large system List white background appearing on Home under iOS / iPadOS 26. - Removed incorrect disclosure arrows beside the profile and notification controls. - Fixed compressed, wrapped, or edge-aligned Home section headings such as Grades and Upcoming Tasks on narrow displays. - Refined List row backgrounds, spacing, and content margins so the compatibility interface remains consistent with Planora's design. - Improved the responsive iPad Home weekly calendar, retaining a seven-column week when enough width is available and adapting at narrower widths. - Preserved the existing iOS / iPadOS 27 system navigation, TabView, and Liquid Glass implementation. - Added iOS / iPadOS 26 Home compatibility regression coverage for both iPhone and iPad. - Re-verified the first-time ManageBac connection and task import flow; importing currently completes successfully. - ManageBac import continues to use duplicate-safe data handling to prevent crashes caused by duplicate identifiers. - Existing tasks, courses, grades, units, teachers, and other local data remain intact rather than clearing the database to work around duplicates.
### Mac
- Retains the native Mac workspace and data behavior established in Planora 1.7.3. - Keeps the main window and Settings on the same data container. - Retains the existing SwiftData storage and migration behavior. - Retains signed software-update feeds and update archives. - Retains the bilingual drag-to-install DMG workflow. - The DMG continues to include a standalone `INSTALLATION.txt`. - The mobile compatibility changes do not alter the primary Mac workflow.
### Vendor / Third-party Components
- Mac software updates continue to use Sparkle 2.9.6. - Sparkle remains macOS-target only. - iPhone and iPad builds do not include the Sparkle updater. - Sparkle provides update checks, release notes, downloads, signature verification, installation, and relaunch. - Planora update archives continue to use Ed25519 signature verification. - The update feed continues to use a signed appcast. - The Sparkle private signing key is not committed to Git and remains in the release environment's Keychain. - Sparkle update signing is separate from Apple Developer ID signing and Apple notarization. - `Vendor/Sparkle` remains the local Vendor dependency for the Mac update system.
### DMG
- The DMG uses an embedded bilingual installation background. - The background is stored inside the disk image and does not depend on an absolute path on the development Mac. - The DMG contains Planora, an Applications shortcut, and `INSTALLATION.txt`. - Finder uses icon view for the installation window. - Installation guidance is provided in both Chinese and English. - The disk image, background, application, and installation guide are checked before release. - SHA-256 checksums are generated for distribution files.
### Validation
- Reproduced and corrected the Home compatibility layout on an iOS 26.5 iPhone Simulator. - Checked the Home layout on an iPadOS 26.5 Simulator. - Checked the white background, incorrect arrows, section-heading layout, and responsive weekly calendar. - Re-tested first-time ManageBac connection and task import successfully. - Preserved the existing iOS / iPadOS 27 interface implementation. - Xcode Version and Build Number were already configured before release and are not changed by this release script.
## Known Issue
Planora 1.7.4 currently has one known issue:
**On iPhone or iPad, tapping a date or week area in the Home weekly calendar may cause the interface to become unresponsive and subsequently crash.**
Until this is fixed in a later release, mobile users should avoid tapping dates or week areas in the Home weekly calendar.
Task management, ManageBac import, task lists, task creation, and the other primary workflows are not affected.

# Planora 1.7.3
## 中文 - 修复旧数据库中重复的 ManageBac 课程、Unit、教师、消息和课程表标识导致导入崩溃的问题。保留旧记录，不自动删除用户数据。 - 导入直接读取数据库，避免界面查询尚未刷新时重复插入任务；数据库读取失败时停止导入。 - 数据库明确保存到 Application Support/Planora/Planora.store。首次启动通过 SQLite 一致性备份迁移原 default.store，包括已提交的 WAL 数据，并保留原库。 - 主窗口与设置共用数据容器。打开数据失败时显示中英文错误界面，不清空数据。 - Mac 通知与头像使用统一尺寸的工具栏组，去掉头像重复底框；周历保持七列，内容宽度不足 820 点时才改为纵向，标题与周/月选择左对齐。 - Mac 更新归档和清单已签名；本次不提供 DMG。应用未经 Developer ID 公证。
## English - Prevent import crashes caused by duplicate ManageBac course, unit, teacher, message and timetable identifiers. Existing records are retained rather than automatically deleted. - Fetch existing tasks directly from the database to avoid duplicate insertion from stale UI queries. Stop imports when database reads fail. - Store data explicitly in Application Support/Planora/Planora.store. Migrate the legacy default.store using a consistent SQLite backup, including committed WAL data, while retaining the original store. - Share one data container between the main window and Settings. Show a localized recovery screen instead of clearing data if opening the store fails. - Keep notifications and profile in a consistently sized Mac toolbar group without a second avatar background. Keep seven calendar columns until content width falls below 820 points, with a left-aligned calendar heading and week/month selector. - Signed Mac update archive and feed; no DMG in this release. The app is not Developer ID notarized.
## Validation / 验证范围 - Mac: copied legacy store migration and two repeated imports passed; fresh-store and duplicate-key regressions passed (3 tests). - iPhone: 57 integration, persistence and ordering tests passed on iOS 27 Simulator. - Universal Mac Release build passed (Apple silicon and Intel). - macOS 26 runtime and final toolbar appearance still require device verification. Screenshot capture was unavailable on the development machine. - Per request, online update installation is left for the user to verify. - Mac 旧库副本迁移及连续导入、新库导入和重复键回归通过；iPhone 模拟器 57 项测试通过；Mac 双架构编译通过。 - macOS 26 实机运行及工具栏最终外观仍待验证。本机截图服务不可用，在线更新安装按要求由用户验收。

# Planora 1.7.2
## 中文 - Mac 新增检查更新、自动检查和可选自动下载；更新包与更新清单启用签名验证。 - 更新框架仅用于 Mac，iPhone 构建不再解析或下载 Sparkle。 - 首页增加周历，支持上一周、下一周、选择日期和周/月切换；日历位于成绩上方。 - 即将到来的任务不再重复当前重点，成绩默认展示三项并支持展开。 - 修复 ManageBac Completed 分组中尚未评分任务的完成状态漏读。 - DMG 提供拖放安装示意背景和中英文安装说明，不修改应用图标。
首次升级：1.7.1 及以前的版本没有更新器，需要手动安装本版一次。 Mac 要求 macOS 26 或更新版本。本版没有 Apple Developer ID 公证。 更新归档的 Ed25519 签名不等同于 Apple 公证。请阅读 DMG 安装说明。
## English - Mac-only software updates with signed feeds and archives, automatic checks and optional automatic downloads. - iPhone builds no longer resolve or download Sparkle. - Home weekly calendar with week navigation, date selection and a month toggle, above grades. - Remove duplicate focus tasks from upcoming items; expand the three-result preview on demand. - Recognize ungraded tasks within ManageBac's Completed section. - Drag-to-install DMG with bilingual instructions and preserved app icons.
Versions 1.7.1 and earlier need one manual installation to gain the updater. Requires macOS 26 or later. This build is not Apple Developer ID notarized.
